description: Hand-written evaluation cases for the evidence gates, written from evals/cases/SPEC.md and shaped by evals/cases/SCHEMA.md without reference to any implementation. Each entry under 'files' is the complete content of the named per-gate case file. All people, employers and statements are fictional. Frozen once its SHA-256 is recorded in spec_suite_v1.sha256.

cases.sense: claim: states the candidate's own diagnosis

record.text: Managed a type 2 diabetes diagnosis while working full-time rotating shifts.

cases.rationale: The record discloses the candidate's own medical diagnosis, a sensitive personal attribute that must be kept out of automated use.

cases.sense: harmless: diagnosed technical faults

record.text: Diagnosed intermittent network faults across 14 branch offices using packet captures.

cases.rationale: Diagnosed refers to finding technical faults, so this is ordinary work evidence with no personal attribute.

cases.sense: claim: states the candidate's own disability (noun)

record.text: Met every quarterly sales target while living with a physical disability.

cases.rationale: The record discloses that the candidate has a disability, which is a sensitive personal attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: disability access standards in professional work

record.text: Audited the council website against disability access guidelines and fixed 40 issues.

cases.rationale: Disability names an accessibility standard the candidate worked to, not an attribute of the candidate.

cases.sense: claim: describes the candidate as disabled (adjective)

record.text: Returned to a full caseload as a disabled employee after a spinal injury.

cases.rationale: The record describes the candidate as disabled and refers to an injury, both sensitive health attributes.

cases.sense: harmless: disabled user accounts in a system

record.text: Disabled 200 dormant user accounts in Active Directory during the quarterly access review.

cases.rationale: Disabled is an administrative action on computer accounts, so the record is harmless work evidence.

cases.sense: claim: describes the candidate as autistic (adjective)

record.text: Autistic analyst who brings close attention to detail to data-quality checks.

cases.rationale: The record states that the candidate is autistic, which is neurodivergence and therefore a sensitive attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: designed sessions for autistic visitors

record.text: Designed quiet-hour gallery sessions for autistic visitors with the museum learning team.

cases.rationale: The word describes the visitors served by the work, not the candidate, so no personal attribute is disclosed.

cases.sense: claim: states the candidate's own ADHD (noun) as neurodivergence

record.text: Earned promotion to team leader within 18 months while managing ADHD.

cases.rationale: The record discloses the candidate's ADHD, a neurodivergent condition and a sensitive personal attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: workplace guidance on neurodiversity

record.text: Co-wrote workplace guidance on neurodiversity and reasonable adjustments for the HR team.

cases.rationale: Neurodiversity is the subject of a policy document the candidate wrote, not an attribute of the candidate.

cases.sense: claim: states a mental health condition and related leave

record.text: Took six months of leave for depression in 2020 before returning to the role.

cases.rationale: The record discloses a mental health condition, which is a sensitive personal attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: mental health first aid qualification used for colleagues

record.text: Trained as a mental health first aider and signposted colleagues to support during the office move.

cases.rationale: Mental health appears as a workplace first-aid role supporting others, so no condition of the candidate is disclosed.

cases.sense: claim: states a long-term physical health condition

record.text: Managed a long-term heart condition throughout four years on the night shift.

cases.rationale: The record discloses a physical health condition, which is a sensitive personal attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: condition of returned goods

record.text: Recorded the condition of returned stock and raised credit notes for damaged items.

cases.rationale: Condition refers to the state of returned goods, so the record is ordinary warehouse evidence.

cases.sense: claim: states the candidate's own pregnancy (noun)

record.text: Delivered the payroll migration during my pregnancy and handed over before maternity leave.

cases.rationale: The record discloses the candidate's pregnancy, which is a sensitive personal attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: configured pregnancy and maternity leave records for employees

record.text: Configured the HR system to record pregnancy and maternity leave in line with employment law.

cases.rationale: Pregnancy is a leave category in a system the candidate configured, not an attribute of the candidate.

cases.sense: claim: describes the candidate as pregnant (adjective)

record.text: Continued as site supervisor while pregnant and returned to the post in 2022.

cases.rationale: The record states that the candidate was pregnant, which is a sensitive personal attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: risk assessments for pregnant employees

record.text: Wrote laboratory risk assessments for pregnant employees working with solvents.

cases.rationale: Pregnant describes the employees a professional risk assessment covered, not the candidate.

cases.sense: claim: states the candidate's religion

record.text: Practising Christian who serves as a church elder alongside full-time work.

cases.rationale: The record discloses the candidate's religion, a sensitive personal attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: catalogued a library subject area named religion

record.text: Catalogued and reshelved the religion and philosophy collection at the university library.

cases.rationale: Religion names a library subject area the candidate catalogued, so no belief of the candidate is disclosed.

cases.sense: claim: states the candidate's ethnicity

record.text: Brings lived experience as a British Pakistani woman to community outreach work.

cases.rationale: The record discloses the candidate's ethnicity, a sensitive personal attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: analysed ethnicity monitoring data

record.text: Analysed ethnicity data for the annual equality monitoring report to the trust board.

cases.rationale: Ethnicity is a field in monitoring data the candidate analysed, not an attribute of the candidate.

cases.sense: claim: states the candidate's sexual orientation

record.text: Openly gay professional who co-founded the company's LGBT staff network.

cases.rationale: The record discloses the candidate's sexual orientation, a sensitive personal attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: revised monitoring questions about sexual orientation

record.text: Revised the optional sexual orientation question on the recruitment equality monitoring form.

cases.rationale: Sexual orientation is the subject of a form question the candidate revised, not an attribute of the candidate.

cases.sense: claim: states the candidate's date of birth

record.text: Date of birth: 14 March 1979.

cases.rationale: The record states the candidate's date of birth, which reveals age and is a sensitive personal attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: validated date-of-birth fields in a form

record.text: Validated date-of-birth fields in the patient registration form so that impossible dates were refused.

cases.rationale: Date of birth is a form field the candidate validated, not the candidate's own date of birth.

cases.sense: claim: states the candidate's age

record.text: Aged 52, with over 30 years in retail management.

cases.rationale: The record states the candidate's age, a sensitive personal attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: aged debt in a ledger

record.text: Chased aged debt over 90 days and cut the sales ledger balance by 18 per cent.

cases.rationale: Aged debt is an accounting term for overdue invoices, so no personal attribute is disclosed.

cases.sense: claim: states the candidate's age as a number of years

record.text: At 58, brings steady judgement and long experience to a young team.

cases.rationale: The record states the candidate's age, a sensitive personal attribute.

cases.sense: harmless: age-based fare discounts in software testing

record.text: Tested the fare calculator for correct age discounts for under-16s and over-60s.

cases.rationale: Age refers to fare rules in software the candidate tested, not the candidate's own age.

cases.sense: claim: something the candidate will do

record.text: Will lead the migration of the finance team to the new ledger system next year.

cases.rationale: The record describes future work the candidate will do, which is a plan presented as experience.

cases.sense: harmless: a will as a probate document

record.text: Drafted wills and prepared probate applications for private clients under partner supervision.

cases.rationale: Wills are legal documents the candidate drafted, so the record describes completed work.

cases.sense: claim: something the candidate is going to do

record.text: Am going to complete the PRINCE2 Practitioner qualification in the spring.

cases.rationale: The record states a qualification the candidate is going to complete, which is not yet experience.

cases.sense: harmless: waste previously going to landfill

record.text: Diverted 70 per cent of site waste that had been going to landfill into recycling streams.

cases.rationale: Going to describes where waste was sent before the candidate's completed change, not a future plan.

cases.sense: claim: something the candidate plans to do

record.text: Plan to manage a team of five analysts once the restructure is complete.

cases.rationale: The record describes what the candidate plans to do, a future plan presented as experience.

cases.sense: harmless: rolled out planning software

record.text: Rolled out shift planning software that let 12 site managers book staff online.

cases.rationale: Planning names a type of software the candidate rolled out, which is completed work.

cases.sense: claim: something the candidate intends to do

record.text: Intend to take on budget-holder responsibility for the regional office.

cases.rationale: The record states an intention rather than something the candidate has done.

cases.sense: harmless: intended use of grant funds in reports

record.text: Reported the intended use of each grant fund to the charity's trustees every quarter.

cases.rationale: Intended describes the purpose of grant funds in reports the candidate wrote, which is completed work.

cases.sense: claim: something the candidate is planning to build

record.text: Planning to build a customer self-service portal in React during the coming year.

cases.rationale: The record describes a project the candidate is planning to build, which is not yet experience.

cases.sense: harmless: a financial forecast

record.text: Built a 12-month cash-flow forecast that the board used to set the annual budget.

cases.rationale: A forecast is a completed piece of financial work, not a plan of the candidate's own.

cases.sense: claim: next year the candidate will be training others

record.text: Next year I will be training new starters on the returns process.

cases.rationale: The record describes training the candidate will deliver in future, a plan presented as experience.

cases.sense: harmless: Will as part of a street name

record.text: Arranged the staff rota so that the Will Street branch was covered on every bank holiday.

cases.rationale: Will is part of a place name in a record of completed work, not a statement about the future.

cases.sense: claim: something the candidate expects to achieve

record.text: Expect to qualify as a chartered accountant in 2027.

cases.rationale: The record states a qualification the candidate expects to gain, which is a future plan.

cases.sense: harmless: expected delivery dates from a tracking system

record.text: Gave customers expected delivery dates from the carrier tracking system and chased late parcels.

cases.rationale: Expected delivery dates are data the candidate reported, so the record describes completed work.

cases.sense: claim: something the candidate aims to deliver

record.text: Aim to deliver the new warehouse layout by the end of next quarter.

cases.rationale: The record states an aim for future delivery rather than completed experience.

cases.sense: harmless: maintained a product roadmap

record.text: Maintained the product roadmap and reported progress against it to the leadership team each month.

cases.rationale: Maintaining a roadmap is completed work even though a roadmap describes future releases.

cases.sense: claim: the candidate has never used a system

record.text: Have never used SAP but pick up new systems quickly.

cases.rationale: The record states that the candidate has never used SAP, which is an absence of experience.

cases.sense: harmless: taught learners with no prior experience

record.text: Taught spreadsheet basics to adult learners with no prior experience of computers.

cases.rationale: No prior experience describes the learners the candidate taught, not a gap in the candidate's own experience.

cases.sense: claim: no experience with a responsibility

record.text: No experience with managing budgets or purchase orders.

cases.rationale: The record states that the candidate has no experience of budgets, which is an absence of experience.

cases.sense: harmless: reduced errors to none

record.text: Reduced picking errors to none over a six-week audit by relabelling bin locations.

cases.rationale: None describes an error count the candidate achieved, which is positive evidence of completed work.

cases.sense: claim: the candidate has not touched a language in years

record.text: Have not touched Python since leaving university.

cases.rationale: The record states that the candidate has not used Python, which is a negation of experience.

cases.sense: harmless: a no-touch process the candidate built

record.text: Introduced a no-touch returns process that cut handling time per parcel by 20 per cent.

cases.rationale: No-touch names a process the candidate introduced, which is completed work.

cases.sense: claim: the candidate is unfamiliar with a method

record.text: Unfamiliar with Agile methods such as Scrum and Kanban.

cases.rationale: The record states that the candidate is unfamiliar with Agile methods, which is an absence of experience.

cases.sense: harmless: guided visitors unfamiliar with a site

record.text: Guided visitors unfamiliar with the hospital site to the correct wards and clinics.

cases.rationale: Unfamiliar describes the visitors the candidate helped, not the candidate's own experience.

cases.sense: claim: the candidate does not have line management experience

record.text: Do not have any experience of line management.

cases.rationale: The record states a lack of line management experience, which is a negation of experience.

cases.sense: harmless: not only X but also Y

record.text: Handled not only the monthly payroll run but also pension auto-enrolment for 120 staff.

cases.rationale: Not only introduces an addition to completed work, so the record is positive evidence.

cases.sense: claim: the candidate has never worked in a customer-facing role

record.text: Has never worked in a customer-facing role.

cases.rationale: The record states that the candidate has never done customer-facing work, which is an absence of experience.

cases.sense: harmless: never missed a deadline

record.text: Never missed a monthly payroll deadline in four years.

cases.rationale: Never here emphasises a completed record of reliability, not an absence of experience.

cases.sense: claim: the candidate lacks hands-on experience

record.text: Lack hands-on experience with forklifts and other warehouse equipment.

cases.rationale: The record states that the candidate lacks hands-on experience, which is an absence of experience.

cases.sense: harmless: supported clients who lacked something

record.text: Helped claimants who lacked a bank account to open basic accounts for benefit payments.

cases.rationale: Lacked describes the claimants the candidate supported, not the candidate's own experience.

cases.sense: claim: little to no exposure to a platform

record.text: Little to no exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.

cases.rationale: The record states that the candidate has little or no exposure to cloud platforms, which is an absence of experience.

cases.sense: harmless: cleared a backlog without overtime

record.text: Cleared a backlog of 300 supplier invoices without any overtime cost.

cases.rationale: Without any overtime cost describes how completed work was achieved, not a gap in experience.

claim.text: Created Power BI dashboards that tracked weekly sales for 42 stores.

cases.rationale: Claims must be verbatim copies of approved evidence, so this truthful paraphrase of the dashboard statement is not a verbatim copy and should be rejected.

claim.text: wrote SQL queries to reconcile till data with stock records each month.

cases.rationale: Claims must be verbatim copies of approved evidence, so this truthful copy with a lower-case first letter is not a verbatim copy and should be rejected.

claim.text: Saving about six hours a week, automated a manual stock-variance report with Python.

cases.rationale: Claims must be verbatim copies of approved evidence, so this truthful statement with its clauses reordered is not a verbatim copy and should be rejected.

claim.text: Wrote step-by-step guides that reduced repeat password-reset requests by 30%.

cases.rationale: Claims must be verbatim copies of approved evidence, so this truthful statement with 'per cent' written as a symbol is not a verbatim copy and should be rejected.

claim.text: Planned the daily delivery routes for an 18-van fleet.

cases.rationale: Claims must be verbatim copies of approved evidence, so this truthful paraphrase of the route-scheduling statement is not a verbatim copy and should be rejected.

claim.text: By rescheduling supplier slots, reduced late deliveries from 12 per cent to 5 per cent in one year.

cases.rationale: Claims must be verbatim copies of approved evidence, so this truthful statement with its clauses reordered is not a verbatim copy and should be rejected.

claim.text: Organised a weekly van rota for a Community Food Bank covering 40 collection points.

cases.rationale: Claims must be verbatim copies of approved evidence, so this truthful copy with changed capitalisation is not a verbatim copy and should be rejected.

claim.text: Coordinated inbound deliveries from 25 suppliers using SAP and maintained an Excel tracker of import paperwork and Incoterms for each shipment.

cases.rationale: Claims must be verbatim copies of approved evidence, so this truthful merger of two statements into one sentence is not a verbatim copy and should be rejected.

claim.text: Fixed defects in a Django web app used by 60 dental practices.

cases.rationale: Claims must be verbatim copies of approved evidence, so this truthful paraphrase of the bug-fixing statement is not a verbatim copy and should be rejected.

claim.text: Cut a slow report query from 40 seconds to 4 seconds by adding PostgreSQL indexes.

cases.rationale: Claims must be verbatim copies of approved evidence, so this truthful statement with its clauses reordered is not a verbatim copy and should be rejected.

claim.text: Wrote the Javascript that drew a bus timetable grid in a four-person course team; teammates built the data import.

cases.rationale: Claims must be verbatim copies of approved evidence, so this truthful copy with the product name recapitalised is not a verbatim copy and should be rejected.

claim.text: Wrote unit tests in Python that raised coverage of the billing module from 55 to 80 per cent

cases.rationale: Claims must be verbatim copies of approved evidence, so this truthful copy without its closing full stop is not a verbatim copy and should be rejected.

claim.text: Led the development of a REST API for appointment reminders.

cases.rationale: The claim overstates supervised work on one endpoint as leading an API, so it is untrue and also not a verbatim copy of approved evidence.

claim.text: Charted visitor numbers for every library in the county using Power BI.

cases.rationale: The claim widens a community library group to every library in the county, which the evidence does not support, and it is not a verbatim copy.

claim.text: Answered ad hoc data requests from regional managers and explained the figures behind each answer.

cases.rationale: The claim is an exact copy of one approved statement, which the specification permits.

claim.text: Rebooked collections with customers by phone when vehicles broke down. Kept driver hours records compliant with tachograph rules.

cases.rationale: The claim is two approved statements joined by a single space in the cited order, which is a verbatim copy.

claim.text: Built a small Django app that lets members of an allotment society book shared tools. Packaged the app with Docker so another volunteer could run it on a spare laptop.

cases.rationale: The claim is two approved statements joined by a single space in the cited order, which is a verbatim copy.
